admin.hebergement.message_it:
Hello,

The reporting tool must send emails (reminders to contributors). To make this possible:
1. Create or choose a sending address (for example, reporting@example.com).
2. Enter these settings in the .env file of the tool (or in the variables of the host):
   SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_SECURITY (starttls or ssl),
   SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD, SMTP_FROM.
3. Restart the tool, then tell me.

The details are in Administration › Settings › Hosting, “For IT” box.
Thank you.

admin.preuves.sauvegardes_note: Backups made before a deletion still hold the file until they are replaced. A restore brings the file back to this list: delete it again. Copies of the backups that IT keeps elsewhere also hold it.

admin.attributions.valid.intro: Each cell gives a validator for one KPI in one organisation and in all the organisations below it. Here, “Assign a validator…” and “Remove a validator…” change validators only.
admin.attributions.valid.legende: A validator checks and validates the values of the KPI in the organisation and below it, and sees the totals of these organisations. A cell marked “via …” is already covered by the validator of an organisation above it: you can still give it its own validator. A cell without a validator is validated by the administrators, who can validate everything. Only active accounts with the validator or administrator role can receive a validator assignment. Select cells, a row or a column to assign many cells at once.

admin.attributions.dessus_pied: Click to give {organisation} its own validator

admin.sante.base.abimee_quoi: Tell your IT team: they restore the last good backup.
admin.sante.base.restauration: A restore was interrupted. The tool finishes it within a minute, or at the next start.
admin.sante.base.restauration_quoi: Reload this page in a few minutes. If the message stays, tell your IT team.
admin.sante.fichiers.bon: The tool can save evidence and the other files.

admin.sante.sauvegarde.aucune: There is no backup of this space yet.
admin.sante.sauvegarde.aucune_quoi: Make a backup now in Hosting.
admin.sante.sauvegarde.future_quoi: The backup has a date in the future. Ask your IT team to check the clock of the server.
admin.sante.sauvegarde.auto_non_quoi: Turn it on in Hosting, or make a backup after each important change.

admin.sante.disque.quoi: Ask your IT team to add disk space or to remove old files.

admin.sante.disque.illisible: The tool cannot read the free disk space.

admin.sante.taches.controle_retard_quoi: Run it now in Hosting. If it stays late, tell your IT team.

admin.sante.migrations.panne: The database is not up to date with this version: some pages can fail.
